paite: Huan Abimelek sih nung in Israelte hunkhe ding in Issakar mi Tola ahong dingkhia a; amah Puah tapa ahi. Puah bel Dodo tapa ahi. Amah Ephraim tanggam Shamir ah ateng hi.
heading: Tola

paite: Kum sawmnih-le-thum sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm a, huchi in asita a, Shamir ah avui uhi.
Huai nung in Gilead mi Jair ahong dingkhia a, kum sawmnih-le-nih sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: Jair

paite: Ama'n sabiltungnou tung a tuang tapa sawmthum anei a, amau Gilead gam ah khua sawmthum anei ua, huaite tuni tan in Havothjair achi lai uhi.
Jair asi a, Kamon ah avui uhi.

Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou hih nawn in Baal leh Ashtaroth, Siriate pathian, Zidonte pathian, Moabte pathian, Ammon suante pathian leh Philistiate pathian nna asem uhi. Huchi in TOUPA alehngatsan ua, ama nna asemta kei uhi.
heading: Ammon Mite Nuaisiahna

paite: Huchi in TOUPA Israelte tung ah ahehta mahmah a, Philistiate leh Ammon suante kiang ah amaute akhawngta hi.
Huai kum in amau Israel suante hihbuai in anuaisiah uhi. Jordan gal Gilead gam a Amorte gam a Israel suan om tengteng kum sawm-le-giat sung anuaisiah uhi.
Ammon suante bel Judahte, Benjaminte, Ephraim inkote dou ding in Jordan agalkah ua; huchi in Israelte alungzing mahmah uhi.
Israel suante'n, "I Pathian in Baalte nna i na sep ziak un hon lehngatsanta, atung ah thil i hihkhialta uh," chi in TOUPA asam uhi.
TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah, "Aiguptate a pan, Amorte a pan, Ammon suante a pan leh Philistiate a pan noute ka hon hunkhe kei maw?
Sidonte, Amalekte leh Ammonte'n leng noute ahon nuaisiah ua; na hon sam ua, huchi in akhut ua kipan ka hon hunkhia hi.
Himahleh noute'n na hon lehngatsan ua, pathian dangte nna na sem zawta uh. Huaiziak in ka hon hunkhe nawn kei ding.
Na pathian telte uh samta unla, amau na gimthuak hun un hon hunkhia uhen," achi hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA kiang ah, "Thil ka na hihkhialta uh. Nang pha na sak bangbang in ka tung uah hih in. Himahleh ka hong thum uhi, tuni in hon hunkhe lai in," chi in.
Huchi in alak ua namdang pathiante akoihmang ua, TOUPA nna asemta uh. Ama'n Israelte lungzinna athuakzou nawnta kei hi.
Ammon suante akikhawm ua, Gilead gam ah ava kikulh ua, Israel suante leng akikhawm ua, Mizpah ah akikulh uhi.
Mipite leh Gilead gam a miliante akihou ua, Ammon suante dou pan ding kua a-om a? Huai mi Gilead gam tengteng tung ah heutu ahi ding, akichi uhi.
